actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Environment steps to advance; the command is applied at every step
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: Normalized muscle command, one value per actuator
inputs.name: action

inputs.description: Normalized muscle excitation in the model's actuator order; the vector length is model-dependent
inputs.name: action.values

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; the native reset takes a JAX key, not an integer seed, so this value is not applied and the output seed is 0
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description: Reset options; the upstream reset takes none, so a non-empty object is refused
inputs.name: options

actions.name: reset_world

facts.text: MyoFullBody is a concrete MuJoCo environment class of a full-body humanoid model with muscle actuation, deriving from LocoEnv
The repository's base class for MuJoCo environments is its own Mujoco class, declared at loco_mujoco/core/mujoco_base.py:44
The constructor defaults are timestep 0.002 s, n_substeps 5 and disable_fingers True
The action specification is every actuator name of the model, in the model's actuator order
Every muscle actuator's control range is set to [-1, 1] with ctrllimited True
The default control function normalizes the agent action space to [-1, 1] and rescales it to the actuator range
When disable_fingers is true the environment deletes the finger joints, finger muscles and their tendons
The README model table lists MyoFullBody as free-root with 123 joints, 416 muscles and 72 DoFs, or 83 joints, 354 muscles and 32 DoFs with finger muscles disabled
The default model XML path is resolved by musclemimic_models.get_xml_path('myofullbody'), a separate package from this clone
musclemimic_models is a declared runtime dependency of the project
The environment registry registers MyoFullBody when the humanoids package is imported
LocoEnv.reset forwards to the MuJoCo reset with a JAX key and returns the initial observation
The MuJoCo reset restores the data with mj_resetData and mj_forward and returns the initial observation
The MuJoCo step preprocesses the action, writes data.ctrl, runs mj_step for n_substeps and returns observation, reward, absorbing, done and info
done is absorbing or the current step count reaches the configured episode horizon
The default episode horizon is 1000 steps
The environment timestep is model.opt.timestep and one environment step advances simulation_dt times n_intermediate_steps times n_substeps

determinism.notes: the native reset takes a JAX random key, not an integer seed; this driver passes no key, so the environment uses its default key 0 and no operator seed selects a trajectory.  The environment's dynamics were not run and the fake was not compared with them.

gaps: the fake backend is a pure Python stand-in: it models a tick, a placeholder muscle-excitation state and a placeholder observation row, but no MuJoCo physics, Hill-type muscle dynamics, contacts, tendons or sensors, and it was never compared with the upstream environment
the model file and its assets are supplied by the separate musclemimic_models package (myofullbody.py:449-453) and are not in this clone; the clone ships no MJCF and the card lists no model

the action vector length and the observation vector length are model-dependent and are not hard-coded here: the environment takes every actuator name (myofullbody.py:394-407) and the README lists 354 muscles with finger muscles disabled (README.md:48), but the actual model was not loaded
the fake accepts a placeholder action width and returns a placeholder observation width; the real environment's dimensions are not exposed by this package or verified
only the default configuration is modelled (disable_fingers True, default observation options, DefaultControl, horizon 1000); other constructor options are not exposed

one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one MuJoCo environment step, which runs n_substeps physics substeps of 0.002 s each (myofullbody.py:56-57, mujoco_base.py:1326-1333), so the default control step is 10 ms
the native reset takes a JAX key, not an integer seed, so the reset seed input is not applied and the fidelity determinism kind is none
snapshot and restore are not offered: this driver declares no checkpoint methods
MuJoCo, JAX, flax and musclemimic_models were not installed or run where the gate ran; only the fake backend is declared
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware
